prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return Solution.java defining public final class Solution.
Required API: public static List<Integer> budgetBatches(List<Integer> weights, int budget)
Behavior: Preserve order and split positive integer weights into non-empty consecutive batches whose sum is at most budget. Budget and weights must be in 1..10,000,000; reject a weight above budget or any intermediate sum above 10,000,000. Empty input returns an empty list. Return batch sums.
Visible example: weights [2,3,4,1] with budget 5 returns batch sums [5,5].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> budgetBatches(List<Integer>w,int b){if(b<=0||b>10000000)return null;var o=new ArrayList<Integer>();int s=0;for(int x:w){if(x<=0||x>10000000||x>b)return null;if(s+x>b){o.add(s);s=0;}s+=x;}if(s>0)o.add(s);return o;}}
